items.definition:
a plant of the buttercup family, with distinctive spurred flowers; a stock character in commedia dell'arte
The garden was full of beautiful columbine flowers.

a person's face or facial expression; support or approval
His calm countenance gave no hint of the turmoil within.

the art of writing or solving codes
Cryptography is essential for securing online communications.

the abandonment of one's country or cause in favor of an opposing one
The defection of the spy caused a major international incident.

inflammation of the skin
She developed contact dermatitis after touching the poisonous plant.

surroundings; environment
The old castle was surrounded by a beautiful natural environ.

a colorless flammable gaseous hydrocarbon
Ethylene is used in the production of plastics.

a chess player of the highest rank
He achieved the title of grandmaster at a very young age.

a person or thing that announces or signals the approach of another
The robin is a harbinger of spring.

a trusted follower, especially one involved in illegal activities
The villain sent his henchman to retrieve the stolen jewels.

a type of people or things similar to those already referred to
We don't want people of that ilk around here.

fairness; lack of bias
The judge's impartiality was crucial for a fair trial.

the action of invoking something or someone for assistance or as an authority
The ceremony began with an invocation for peace.

the state of being mad; extreme folly
It would be sheer lunacy to attempt that climb without proper equipment.

a heavy, thick, woollen cloth
The coat was made of a warm melton fabric.

a ruler in an oligarchy; a very rich and powerful business leader
The country was controlled by a small group of oligarchs.

the emission of ionizing radiation or particles
The accident caused a dangerous level of radioactivity.

a subordinate who does menial or unprincipled work for another
He was just a stooge for the real criminals.

great courage, especially in battle
His valour on the battlefield earned him a medal.

a hypothetical shortcut through spacetime
Scientists theorize about the existence of wormholes.

a large seabird; a burden or curse
The old factory became an albatross around the company's neck.

an underground layer of water-bearing permeable rock
The region's water supply comes from a large underground aquifer.

the action of surrendering or ceasing to resist an opponent or demand
The enemy's capitulation marked the end of the war.

either of the two main arteries that carry blood to the head and neck
The doctor checked the pulse in her carotid artery.

A person or thing that emits something.
The device acts as an infrared emitter.

A large retail store, especially one selling a wide variety of goods.
The new department store was a true shopping emporium.

An anesthetic injected into the epidural space around the spinal cord, especially to numb the lower body during childbirth.
She received an epidural during labor to manage the pain.

letter; written communication
He received a long epistle from his aunt.

the state or quality of being ferocious; savagery
The ferocity of the storm surprised everyone.

the quality of being fluid or flowing; gracefulness
The dancer moved with remarkable fluidity.

a top-floor room, especially a small one, just below a sloping roof
The artist lived in a small garret.

a small picturesque cave, especially an artificial one in a park or garden
The garden featured a beautiful stone grotto.

the fire of hell; damnation
The preacher warned of eternal hellfire.

the handle of a weapon or tool, especially a sword, dagger, or knife
He gripped the sword by its hilt.

the remote areas of a country away from the coast or the banks of major rivers
The city served as a trading hub for the vast agricultural hinterland.

the process of teaching a person or group to accept a set of beliefs uncritically
The cult used various methods of indoctrination on its new members.

the quality of being certain to happen
The inevitability of change is a constant in life.

conflict or rivalry among members of a group or organization
The political party was weakened by constant infighting.

a violation or infringement of a law or agreement
He received a penalty for a minor traffic infraction.

an allusive or oblique remark or hint, typically a derogatory one
His speech was full of subtle innuendoes about his opponent.

Theft of personal property.
He was charged with grand larceny after stealing the car.

The intrinsic brightness of a celestial object; brightness.
The luminosity of the star was immense.

A follower of the political theories of Mao Zedong.
The group identified themselves as Maoists.

A heavy hammer.
He used a maul to split the logs.

A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.
His comments revealed him to be a misogynist.

A particular mode in which something exists or is experienced or expressed.
The doctor discussed different treatment modalities.

the state or quality of being obscene; an obscene act, utterance, or item
The film was criticized for its gratuitous obscenity.

a public speaker, especially one who is eloquent or skilled
He was a gifted orator, captivating his audience with every speech.

a large, imposing building, especially a public one or a palace
The Palais Garnier is a famous opera house in Paris.

the state or quality of lasting forever
The land was granted to the family in perpetuity.

a condition or system in which two or more states, groups, principles, sources of authority, etc., coexist
Cultural pluralism is a hallmark of modern democratic societies.

the preying of one animal on others
The study examined the effects of predation on the deer population.

a state that is controlled and protected by another
The island became a British protectorate in the 19th century.

a dividing wall or membrane between two cavities or masses of soft tissue
He had a deviated nasal septum.

a servomechanism; a power-assisted steering system
The car's power steering servo failed.

the layer of the earth's atmosphere above the troposphere
The ozone layer is located in the stratosphere.

a person who believes in the unity of God
He was raised as a Unitarian.

the combining power of an element; emotional value
The valence of carbon is four.

a person highly skilled in music or another artistic pursuit
He was a piano virtuoso by the age of ten.

a fragrant plant
Sweet woodruff is often used in traditional German drinks.

a chemical element (Xe)
Xenon is a noble gas used in some specialized lighting.

the point at which something is best or most highly developed
He reached the acme of his career at age 40.

an action or remark that causes outrage or offense
His rude comments were a direct affront to her dignity.

friendly relations
The two nations lived in amity for decades.
